slots.node11.text: Northfield runs 14 clinical and revenue systems, and every pair that exchanges data has its own interface. The 61 feeds fail in different ways, and each new system adds more.
slots.node12.body.item01.p: Publish clinical and revenue events to one managed event bus. Systems subscribe to the events they need, so a new feed no longer changes the sending system.
slots.node12.label: Decision
slots.node14.items.item01: One place to monitor and replay every event
slots.node14.items.item02: New systems connect in weeks, not quarters
slots.node16.items.item01: The platform team must run a new service around the clock
slots.node16.items.item02: Interface teams need training in event design
slots.node17.text: Review in September 2027, or sooner if feed incidents rise.
slots.title: ADR-014: Route clinical events through a [[shared event bus]]
